breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly follows the incorrect instruction by setting M = P·L (constant peak value) over the full span, forming U = (P²L³)/(2EI), and arriving at δ = PL³/(EI) ≈ 10.55 mm. The ground truth requires using the actual varying moment M(x) = P(L - x), which yields U = P²L³/(6EI) and δ = PL³/(3EI) ≈ 3.52 mm. The agent repeated the original error rather than fixing it.
